subject: Novix demo — calendar permission block and host reassignment
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Romero <alex.romero@novix.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Nov 2028 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Novix demo — scheduling check and calendar token behavior

Alex —

Thanks again for agreeing to the product walkthrough next week. I set up the calendar invite for Tue 11/21 at 11:00am PT and invited your team (Jordan and yourself). Ben and Monica are on our side for the demo and will handle the technical portion.

Quick note — several customers on GSuite domains have seen the organizer field get stripped when the invite is forwarded inside large organizations, which makes the RSVP/"Join" button vanish for external guests. If you or Jordan don’t see the meeting link in the invite (or can’t RSVP), please let me know right away and we’ll send a short ICS rewrap with an alternate organizer.

Proposed next steps if permissions are blocked:
- Send a plain-calendar ICS from our side with Novix as the organizer (short-term rebind)
- Post the Zoom link in a separate email (temporary fallback) and request moderator transfer at the start of the call
- Follow up with your calendar admin afterward if you want organizer ownership to persist

Attaching the current event as an ICS in case that helps.

Attachment: novix_demo.ics (text/calendar)

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Alex Romero <alex.romero@novix.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@novix.io>
Date: Thu, 15 Nov 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novix demo — scheduling check and calendar token behavior

Thanks Rachel —

I just checked with Jordan and the invite landed in his calendar but the body is empty and the "Join" button is missing. When he opens details it shows: "External organizer blocked by domain policy". Our security team has a rule that strips external organizer metadata for auto-forwarded invites.

Can you do the ICS rewrap you mentioned? If possible, make Novix the organizer so our SSO will surface the join button.

Appreciate it —
Alex
Senior IT Project Manager, Novix

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Romero <alex.romero@novix.io>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Nov 2028 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novix demo — calendar permission block and host reassignment

Alex —

Thanks for flagging. Quick workaround we use in these cases: I can send a minimal ICS from an inbox that uses a Novix-verified alias so your domain sees Novix as the organizer. That rewrap typically restores the "Join" button and RSVP behavior.

If you prefer not to touch calendars, we can also: 
- Send the Zoom meeting link in a plain email to all attendees (I’ll paste the link below)
- During the call I’ll request moderator handoff so Jordan (or someone at Novix) becomes host after we start

Temporary Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/999888777 (passcode: demo2028)

Rachel — can you confirm if Novix wants the organizer ownership to stay on their side after the meeting? If so I’ll do the ICS rewrap and set Novix as organizer. If not, the link-only fallback will work and we can avoid touching your client calendars.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Alex Romero <alex.romero@novix.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Nov 2028 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novix demo — calendar permission block and host reassignment

Ben — please go ahead with the ICS rewrap and set Novix as the organizer for this event. Alex — we’ll keep your team as the owner in the rewrapped event so your SSO and RSVP show correctly.

Monica — can you also attach a plain-text file with the Zoom link to the rewrapped invite (some clients show attachments more reliably than a pasted body). I created a short temp link file you can include: temp_zoom_link.txt

Alex / Jordan — final confirmation: we’ll keep the original time Tue 11/21 11:00am PT. If anything changes on your side, reply-all and we’ll reschedule.

Thanks —
Rachel

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Alex — attaching the rewrapped event (novix_demo.ics) and a small text stub with the Zoom link so it surfaces in clients that strip HTML.

Attachment: novix_demo.ics (text/calendar)
Attachment: temp_zoom_link.txt (text/plain)

If you do not see the join button after this, please forward the invite to your security admin and CC me — we’ll coordinate an org-level exception.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
